title: Optimizing Test-Time Compute via Meta Reinforcement Finetuning
authors_zh: Yuxiao Qu, Matthew Y. R. Yang, Amrith Setlur, Lewis Tunstall, Edward Emanuel Beeching, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Aviral Kumar
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: Optimizing Test-Time Compute via Meta Reinforcement Finetuning records test-time episodes and reasoning fragments under success-probability-change bonus plus outcome reward.
MRT 把思考过程切分为 episode，并以元证明器估计的进展奖励辅助终局强化学习。
why: It makes meta-RL allocates test-time compute and its audit boundary visible for reasoning-data curation.
inclusion_reason: Approved Track 5 candidate with a concrete feedback/selection object: test-time episodes and reasoning fragments.

title: Problem
问题
html: The paper asks how a reasoning model should spend an unknown test-time token budget. Merely rewarding the final answer does not distinguish useful exploration, verification, and backtracking from redundant tokens. The relevant data object is therefore a problem with oracle solution information plus a generated token stream segmented into attempts or episodes, together with outcome and progress signals at episode prefixes.
论文研究推理模型应如何使用事先未知的测试时 token 预算。只奖励最终答案无法区分有用的探索、验证和回溯与冗余 token。相应的数据对象是带有 oracle 解答信息的问题，以及被分割为多次尝试或 episode 的生成 token 流，并附带终局结果和各 episode 前缀的进展信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Meta Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (MRT) treats successive attempts inside one response as an in-context adaptation process. Instead of assuming every episode must itself be a better solution, it measures whether adding an episode increases a separate meta-prover's probability of recovering the correct answer. That estimated progress becomes a dense bonus added to the terminal outcome objective, encouraging exploration and exploitation that remain useful across budgets.
Meta Reinforcement Fine-Tuning（MRT）把一次回答中的连续尝试视为上下文内适应过程。它不要求每个 episode 本身都给出更优解，而是估计加入该 episode 后，另一个 meta-prover 得到正确答案的概率是否上升。该进展估计作为稠密奖励加到终局结果目标中，鼓励在不同预算下仍有用的探索与利用。

title: Method
方法
html:
The setup assumes training problems, oracle solution traces ending in correct answers, and a queryable reward function. Output is segmented into episodes such as attempts, verification/generation blocks, or paths separated by backtracking. Progress is the change in a meta-prover's answer probability after observing another episode. The implementation collapses episode bonuses into one progress-adjusted reward for compatibility with outcome-RL systems.

For STaR experiments, the authors sample 10,000 NuminaMath problem–solution pairs and estimate backtracking progress with 20 rollouts per prefix. RL experiments use 4,000 NuminaMath problems for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and 919 AIME 1989–2023 problems for DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview. Training and evaluation use a 16K maximum output budget. These are experiment-specific construction settings, not a released universal dataset specification.

该设定假定存在训练问题、以正确答案结束的 oracle 解答轨迹，以及可查询的奖励函数。输出可被划分为多次尝试、验证/生成块，或由回溯标记分隔的路径。进展定义为 meta-prover 在观察新增 episode 后，给正确答案分配的概率变化。实现把 episode 奖励合并为一个经进展调整的总奖励，以兼容结果奖励 RL 系统。

STaR 实验随机抽取 10,000 对 NuminaMath 问题—解答，并对每个前缀做 20 次 rollout 估计回溯进展。RL 实验中，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 使用 4,000 条 NuminaMath 问题，DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview 使用 919 条 1989–2023 年 AIME 问题；训练与评测的最大输出预算为 16K。这些是具体实验构造设置，不是已发布通用数据集规范。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper compares MRT with outcome-only GRPO, length penalties, and STaR variants on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, and analyzes episode-conditioned progress on AIME 2024 and a 40-problem Omni-MATH subset. Ablations examine progress bonuses and compute allocation. This evidence tests whether the reward design changes model behavior. It does not validate the correctness or licensing of every source solution, generated episode, or progress label, and benchmark pass rates are not data-quality measurements.
论文在数学推理基准上比较 MRT、仅结果奖励的 GRPO、长度惩罚和 STaR 变体，并在 AIME 2024 与 40 题 Omni-MATH 子集上分析 episode 条件化进展；消融还考察进展奖励和算力分配。这些证据用于检验奖励设计是否改变模型行为，不能验证每条源解答、生成 episode 或进展标签的正确性与许可；benchmark 通过率不是数据质量指标。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The distinctive contribution is a feedback contract for intermediate attempts that does not require step-level correctness labels. An episode may be locally wrong yet receive credit if it helps the meta-prover make a better final prediction. This separates “progress for future inference” from “current answer correctness” and offers a construction recipe for budget-aware RL traces rather than a standalone corpus release.
其主要贡献是不依赖逐步骤正确性标签的中间尝试反馈契约。某个 episode 即使局部错误，只要帮助 meta-prover 更好地预测最终答案，也可能获得正向信号。该设计区分“对后续推理有帮助的进展”与“当前答案正确性”，提供的是预算感知 RL 轨迹构造方法，而不是独立语料发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Progress is model-based: it inherits the meta-prover's calibration, prompting, sampling variance, and possible overlap with the generator. Twenty prefix rollouts are only an estimator, and segmentation based on discourse markers can miss semantic episode boundaries. The method assumes a reliable terminal reward and oracle solutions. Complete generated rollouts, prefix-level estimates, rejection logs, and an immutable training artifact are not documented as released; their availability is unknown.
进展信号由模型估计，会继承 meta-prover 的校准误差、提示敏感性、采样方差以及与生成器可能存在的相关偏差。每个前缀 20 次 rollout 只是估计；基于话语标记的分段也可能漏掉真实语义边界。方法还假定终局奖励和 oracle 解答可靠。完整生成 rollout、前缀级估计、拒绝日志及不可变训练工件未被说明为已发布，其可用性为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: MRT is useful when building long-form reasoning data with repeated attempts and only answer-level verification. A reusable record should retain problem/source IDs, oracle answer and checker, episode boundaries, all prefix rollouts, meta-prover version and probabilities, terminal reward, progress bonus, and token budget. This permits recalculation under a different verifier and prevents the learned bonus from being mistaken for ground-truth process quality.
MRT 适用于构建包含多次尝试、但只有答案级验证的长推理数据。可复用记录应保留问题与来源 ID、oracle 答案及检查器、episode 边界、全部前缀 rollout、meta-prover 版本与概率、终局奖励、进展奖励和 token 预算。这样可以用不同验证器重新计算，也能避免把学习型奖励误当作过程质量真值。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read MRT as both a formalization and a reward-construction recipe.
  • Cumulative regret is the analysis target; the practical signal is a surrogate progress bonus.
  • NuminaMath and AIME provide source problems, while episodes and bonuses are generated during training.
  • Progress is estimated by a meta-prover and is not ground-truth process quality.
  • Exact trace artifacts and their revisions remain unknown unless separately verified.

• 应把 MRT 同时视为形式化框架和奖励构造方法。
  • 累积遗憾是分析目标，实际训练信号是代理进展奖励。
  • NuminaMath 与 AIME 提供源问题，episode 与奖励在训练期间生成。
  • 进展由 meta-prover 估计，不是过程质量真值。
  • 若不另行核验，具体轨迹工件及其版本仍为 unknown。
